en: The image shows a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of an octagonal baptistery surrounded by intricate mosaic flooring. The structure is identified as part of the Roman ruins of Timgad, specifically a Byzantine baptistery. The setting is indoors with visible brick walls, and the style of the photo and card suggests an early-to-mid 20th-century production.
